factor_contract.availability_reason: The floor is intentionally later than the IMF documented first-full-week publication cadence and remains a conservative present-vintage approximation, not vintage proof.

prohibited_variants: Do not add inventories, futures curves, other metals, China data, the dollar, equities, oil, inflation, rates, CFTC, BTC price, trend, volatility or on-chain inputs.
Do not invert direction, change the three-month comparison horizon, alter the 75-day availability floor, add smoothing, magnitude thresholds, fractional sizing, shorting or leverage.
Do not substitute another FRED, IMF, World Bank, exchange, vendor or manually exported series after source access.
stop_conditions: Stop before factor evaluation if transport, header, byte ceiling, exact monthly lattice, positivity, row count, date bounds or present-vintage identity fails.
Stop before BTC outcomes if either Design or Validation state and transition support fails.
Stop after one source attempt regardless of result; no same-cycle rescue or hypothesis is allowed for this newly admitted family.
scope_note: No PCOPPUSDM source probe was executed and no historical factor value or BTC outcome was accessed; no hypothesis, manifest, runner, candidate, OOS, paid API, second timer, second writer, canonical write, Production, Trading, database, order, fund, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE action occurred.
